N6.reason: A string of disconnected, often contradictory declarative sentences, for example a 'diary supplies none' after just being said to expose an omission, and 'no frost' and 'receipts never fall' set side by side, with abrupt tense shifts. It has no narrative or argumentative thread and does not read as published prose.
